entities.summary: Javad Saeed was an Iranian politician who served as the last Speaker of the Parliament of Iran during the Pahlavi era, and was the last secretary-general of the Resurgence Party and the deputy Secretary-General of the Rastakhiz Party during the second tenure of Jamshid Amouzegar and his own tenure. He represented Sari in the parliament.
